name: autoresearch
description: Karpathy's autoresearch loop under OpenShell: an agent edits one training script, trains a small GPT for a fixed time budget, and keeps or discards each change by validation bits per byte. The fixed data, tokenizer, evaluator, and scorer are baked read-only into the sandbox image; the harness writes the ledger. The laptop profile runs on CPU inside Docker on a Mac; the station profile is the GPU configuration for a DGX Station.

driver.resumeNudge: Continue the experiment loop. First check `git log --oneline -5` and the tail of run.log so you know where you left off. Then run exactly one more experiment: edit train.py, commit, run it, read val_bpb, keep or discard. Submit at most one policy proposal this turn, then return; the harness resumes you.
